risks.risk: Brand/model may not be Roadmaster; could be a different make with similar frame styling.
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up photo of the frame head tube/logo and any serial/model plate (and the rear derailleur/gear shifter markings).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used sport bicycle with front suspension (worst case vs claimed brand/model).

risks.risk: Gear system details may be different (number/type of gears, whether shifting works smoothly).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of shifting through all gears while pedaling (front and rear), plus a close-up of the shifters and rear derailleur.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed for smooth shifting (worst case: needs adjustment/servicing).

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible: wheel trueness, brake wear, chain/cassette wear, bent rim, or loose headset.
risks.proof: Ask for: (1) close-up of brake pads and rotors/rims, (2) tire tread and sidewall condition, (3) a video showing the wheels spin straight and brakes stop firmly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible maintenance needs (worst case: brakes/drive may need service).

risks.risk: Frame size/fit unknown; could affect value for the buyer even if it rides.
risks.proof: Ask for a measurement photo: seat tube length (center to top) and stand-over height, or the size marking on the frame.
risks.if_unproven: Price without size premium (worst case: unknown fit).

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the frame head tube/logo and any serial/model plate (to confirm 'Roadmaster').
Video of shifting through all gears while pedaling (front and rear), plus close-ups of shifters and rear derailleur.
Video of wheel spin (straightness) and a brake test clip showing firm stopping.
Close-ups of chain, cassette/freewheel, brake pads, and tire tread/sidewalls.
response.reason: The photos confirm a sport bicycle with front suspension, but the key details that set the price (exact brand/model and gear specification/working condition) are not readable or verifiable from the single image.
